title: CyberDeck Control-Plane Error
description: Coded error model for the control plane. `retryable` drives the middleware retry/backoff (CD-126): a client may retry retryable errors, must not retry non-retryable ones. CD-113.

code.description: stable machine code; the enum is the whole vocabulary — no free-form codes

retryable.description: true ⇒ the same request may succeed later (rate_limited/unavailable/timeout/internal); false ⇒ deterministic failure the client must fix (bad_request/validation_failed/not_found/…)

details.description: optional structured context, e.g. field errors for validation_failed

retryAfterMs.description: hint for rate_limited/unavailable: earliest sensible retry delay
